messages:
Maya: quick async — proposing a small change to streaming chat deltas that might touch tool-calling. TL;DR: rename `event` -> `type` and add a `tool_call` nested object for function-call streams. Need quick signoff or a rollback plan. (cc @Kevin)

Kevin: quick q: will this break SDK consumers if we keep the old `event` field as an alias?

Maya: plan is to keep `event` as an alias for 3 weeks, then remove. runtime will accept both for the window. need to confirm client reassembly semantics — we don't want silent reassembly bugs.

Samir: can you paste old vs new payload examples?

Maya: current (stream emits simple deltas):
```json
{"event":"delta","delta":{"content":"hello"}}
```

Maya: proposed shape:
```json
{"type":"delta","delta":{"content":"hello"},"tool_call":{"name":null,"args":null}}
```

Elena: how will tool-call partials look? e.g., streaming args across multiple messages mid-call?

Maya: mid-call we'll stream `tool_call` with `args` as fragment strings and emit `tool_call.complete=true` on the terminal fragment. runtime will also include `tool_call_id` to correlate fragments. Example (illustrative):
```json
{"type":"tool_delta","tool_call":{"tool_call_id":"abc123","args":"{\"text\":\"par"}"}}
{"type":"tool_delta","tool_call":{"tool_call_id":"abc123","args":"t\"}","tool_call.complete":true}}
```

Samir: hmm. that second example has messy fields and escaping — can we standardize so `tool_call` is always an object with optional fields `{id, args_fragment, complete}`? fewer ad-hoc keys -> easier reassembly for SDKs.

Kevin: agreed. also propose we ship an opt-in header `X-Redwood-Compat: event-alias` during canary so clients can exercise both code paths before we remove the old alias.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: rollout 5% -> us-west-2. Monitor: infra/alerts#streaming-latency.

Maya: I'll update the API contract doc and add a migration example + SDK reassembly snippet. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/inference/pull/4823 :eyes: 

Elena: if the first hour looks stable, bump canary to 10% and add an alert on `tool_call_reassembly_errors`.

Kevin: I'll review the PR right after stand. ping me with `@Kevin` if you need an immediate review. :thumbsup:

Maya: thanks — I'll also add a short rollback runbook (feature-flag off + server-side alias retained), and post an RFC link later in #eng-platform.
